responsibility: Find visually or functionally similar products from an image, name, or description. Use when the user asks to "find something like this", match a product from a photo, or source alternates to a given item.
inputs: Supplied task and selected source scope; exact destination only for requested persistence or application work. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only for an explicitly requested standalone comparison/pairing report; preserve complete staged and actual destination byte/access readback. Registered project output delegates to its document owner.

For requested library saves hand off to the complete native product-library owner with preview/current-hash/request-ID and readback safeguards; master-schedule owns canonical adoption/revisions. Recommendations do not authorize either mutation.
